info.name: S5W — client API
info.description:
# S5W — client API

Everything an application needs from S5W: put a file in, get a link to it, deliver it.
Full documentation: https://winterframe.net/en/apps/s5w/overview

## Getting started — 3 steps

1. **Import** this file into Postman — it holds everything needed.
2. **Fill in two variables** of the collection: open the collection → **Variables** tab:

| Variable | What it is | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | the API address, scheme included, no trailing `/` | `https://s5.example.com` |
| `token` | a bucket token from the admin panel, "full access" level | `s5w_9f3c…` |

3. **Send "0. Check the token".** A `200` means everything is set.

> **Put the token into "Current value"** and leave "Initial value" empty. The current value stays
> on your machine and never gets exported — the collection can be shared safely.

## How requests work

Everything an application needs from S5W: put a file in, get a link to it, deliver it.

**The bucket is decided by the token.** It is not part of any API address: a token is issued
for one bucket and works only there.

**Token levels:** `BASIC` ("delivery only" in the panel) — `GET /v1/check` and downloads from
`/p/{id}`; `FULL` ("full access") — everything.

**Formats.** Lists answer `{ "meta": {…}, "data": [ … ] }`. Errors answer `{ "code", "message" }`,
plus per-field `errors` when validation failed. Enumerations are sent as numbers in requests
(`"retention": 3`), except the string `format`; responses carry them as an object
`{ "id": 3, "name": "MONTH" }`. Deleting answers `204` with an empty body.

**Time** is RFC 3339 (ISO 8601) with a time zone: `2026-11-08T17:10:44+00:00`. The same in
every response; standard libraries parse it as is.

## Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` / `201` | success / created |
| `204` | deleted, no body |
| `400` | no file sent; an empty or too small upload chunk |
| `401` | no token, or the token is unknown |
| `403` | the token is disabled, expired, or its level is too low |
| `404` | no such file, upload, link, or folder (on `/v1/folders/{name}`) |
| `409` | conflict: the name is taken, the chunk offset does not match, the upload is not finished |
| `413` | over the quota, a body over 32 MiB, a chunk over 16 MiB |
| `422` | validation failed, the given folder does not exist, the hash does not match, the image cannot be processed |
| `507` | the server is running out of disk space |

## Running it all

Press **Run** on the collection — the requests go top to bottom. Each one stores what the next
needs, and **"8. Cleanup"** deletes everything created — the run can be repeated. Only two requests
of section 2 need a file from disk — pick it in the **Body** tab; without it only they fail.

The same API as an OpenAPI spec is `openapi.yaml` next to this file.

request.description:
Checks the token and shows which bucket it belongs to, its access level and how much space is
left.

Use it as the first request — to make sure the address and the token are right. In an
application — for example at start-up, to notice a revoked token at once.

**Token:** `BASIC`

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The token is accepted. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `403` | The token is disabled, expired, or its level is too low. |

exec: pm.test('the run needs a FULL token', () => pm.expect(json.access.name).to.eql('FULL'));

item.name: 1. Folders
item.description:
Optional grouping of files. A folder gives its files common rules — visibility, retention
and caching. **The bucket root is always public**: keep private files in a folder with
`public: false`.

request.description:
Creates a folder in the bucket. Folders do not nest.

Retention counts from the upload of each file; expired files are deleted by themselves, every
5 minutes.

> Here the name is generated (`demo-…`) so the run can be repeated.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Letters, digits, space, `.`, `_`, `-`; starts with a letter or a digit. |
| `public` | boolean |  | `true` — files of the folder open at `/o/…` without a token. |
| `retention` | `0` · `1` · `2` · `3` · `4` · `5` · `6` |  | Retention of the files. (`0` forever, `1` a day, `2` a week, `3` a month, `4` a quarter, `5` half a year, `6` a year) |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `201` | The folder is created. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `409` | Such a folder already exists. |
| `422` | The name does not fit. |

response.name: 422 — invalid name

request.description:
Returns the folders of the bucket page by page.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query |  | Page number, from 1. |
| `limit` | query |  | Records per page. |
| `search` | query |  | Search by name. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of folders. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |

Returns one folder by its name.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | Folder name. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The folder. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such folder. |

Changes the name, visibility and retention. The body is the same as on creation; every field is
set anew.

The change applies at once to the files already in the folder:

- **visibility** changes for every file: close the folder and their `/o/…` stops working;
- **retention** is recalculated for every file **from its upload date**. Shorten it and the
  files older than the new term are deleted at the next sweep — within 5 minutes.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | Folder name. |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Letters, digits, space, `.`, `_`, `-`; starts with a letter or a digit. |
| `public` | boolean |  | `true` — files of the folder open at `/o/…` without a token. |
| `retention` | `0` · `1` · `2` · `3` · `4` · `5` · `6` |  | Retention of the files. (`0` forever, `1` a day, `2` a week, `3` a month, `4` a quarter, `5` half a year, `6` a year) |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The folder. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such folder. |
| `409` | The new name is taken. |
| `422` | Validation failed. |

Sets the `Cache-Control` header for the files of the folder — instead of the bucket policy.
`null` in a field — inherit from the bucket.

For private files and the `/p`, `/t` channels the visibility is never above `PRIVATE`, and
`max-age` never longer than what is left of the file or the link.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | Folder name. |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxAge` | integer | null |  | Seconds to cache. |
| `visibility` | `1` · `2` · `3` |  | Who caches. (`1` shared cache: browser and CDN, `2` browser only, `3` do not cache) |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The folder with the new `cache`. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such folder. |

item.name: 2. Single-request upload
item.description:
For files up to **32 MiB**: one `multipart/form-data` request and the file is ready. Pick the file
in the **Body** tab; without it the request answers `400`, but the run goes on.

request.description:
Uploads a file in one `multipart/form-data` request and returns its addresses at once. The
limit is **32 MiB** for the whole request; larger files go through the chunked upload.

**The name** is unique within the folder: when taken, a number is added — `photo (1).png`. `/`,
`\` and control characters are replaced with `-`.

**Deduplication.** When the bucket already holds this content, no disk space and no quota are
spent, and the answer says `deduplicated: true`.

**Image processing.** With `format`, `maxWidth`, `maxHeight`, `quality` the image is shrunk,
rotated by EXIF and re-encoded before it is stored; the result is what is kept. Images are only
shrunk, animation is left alone. Changing the format changes the extension too:
`photo.png` → `photo.webp`.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes | The file itself. |
| `folder` | string |  | Folder name. Without it — the bucket root, and the file is public. |
| `name` | string |  | File name. Without it — the name of the uploaded file. |
| `format` | `ORIGINAL` · `WEBP` · `JPEG` · `PNG` · `AVIF` |  | Output format; `ORIGINAL` — keep. |
| `maxWidth` | integer |  | Shrink to this width, keeping proportions. |
| `maxHeight` | integer |  | Shrink to this height, keeping proportions. |
| `quality` | integer |  | Quality; without it — by format: AVIF 55, PNG 60, WEBP and JPEG 82. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `201` | The file is uploaded. |
| `400` | No file was sent. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `403` | The token is disabled, expired, or its level is too low. |
| `413` | Over the bucket quota, or the request is over 32 MiB. |
| `422` | The given folder does not exist, validation failed, or the image cannot be processed. |

item.name: 3. Chunked upload
item.description:
For large files and unreliable networks: the file goes in chunks of 4–16 MiB and resumes
from what arrived after a break. Order: start → send chunks → complete.

request.description:
Opens an upload: the server checks the quota and the free disk space up front and returns the
upload `id` and the recommended chunk size `chunkSize`. The upload waits 24 hours to be continued.

**Deduplication by `sha256`.** When the bucket already holds this content, the file is created at
once: the answer has `chunkSize: 0` and a ready `file` with `deduplicated: true` — no chunks and
no completion are needed. With image options the hash lookup is skipped: the hash is of the
source, while the processed result is what gets stored.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Name of the future file. |
| `size` | integer | yes | File size, bytes. |
| `sha256` | string |  | Content hash, 64 hex characters: integrity check on completion and deduplication. |
| `folder` | string |  | Folder name. Checked at once: `422` when it does not exist. |
| `format` | `ORIGINAL` · `WEBP` · `JPEG` · `PNG` · `AVIF` |  | Output format; `ORIGINAL` — keep. |
| `maxWidth` | integer |  | Shrink to this width, keeping proportions. |
| `maxHeight` | integer |  | Shrink to this height, keeping proportions. |
| `quality` | integer |  | Quality; without it — by format: AVIF 55, PNG 60, WEBP and JPEG 82. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `201` | The upload is open — or the file was created at once by `sha256`. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `413` | Over the bucket quota. |
| `422` | The given folder does not exist, or validation failed. |
| `507` | Less than 512 MiB would be left on the server disk. |

response.name: 413 — over the quota

exec: // In this example the "file" is a short text, so the run needs no file picked.
// In an app these are the bytes of a real file; size and sha256 are computed from them.
const text = 'Hello from S5W! This content was uploaded in chunks. ' + Date.now();

request.description:
Appends the next chunk to the upload. **The body is the raw bytes of the chunk** — not JSON, not
a form. Repeat until `offset` in the answer equals `size`.

A chunk is 4 to 16 MiB; only the last one may be smaller. Send `Upload-Offset`: when a chunk is
lost or sent twice, the server answers `409` instead of producing a corrupted file.

> In this example the whole "upload" fits in one chunk — it is the last one and may be small.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | Upload id from `POST /v1/uploads`. |
| `Upload-Offset` | header |  | The byte this chunk starts at. Optional, but worth sending. |

**Request body:** raw bytes — The chunk bytes, 4–16 MiB (the last one — any size).

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The chunk is accepted; `offset` is the new position. |
| `400` | The chunk is empty, or under 4 MiB and not the last. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | The upload does not exist or has expired. |
| `409` | `Upload-Offset` does not match what has arrived. |
| `413` | The chunk is over 16 MiB or past the declared `size`. |

response.name: 409 — offset mismatch
400 — chunk under 4 MiB and not last

request.description:
The state of the upload: `offset` is how many bytes the server has. After a break, continue from there.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | Upload id from `POST /v1/uploads`. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The upload. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | The upload does not exist or has expired. |

response.name: 404 — no such upload

request.description:
Closes the upload and creates the file: checks the hash, processes the image when asked, moves the content into storage.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | Upload id from `POST /v1/uploads`. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `201` | The file is created. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | The upload does not exist or has expired. |
| `409` | Not everything has arrived. |
| `422` | The content does not match `sha256`; the upload is deleted. |

item.name: Skip the transfer when the file is already there

request.description:
The same "Start an upload" request, but with the hash of content the bucket already holds (from
step 1). The server creates the file on it at once — **without sending the bytes**.

**How to tell it worked:** `chunkSize: 0`, and `file` holds a ready file with `deduplicated: true`.
No chunks and no completion are needed. Without such content the answer is as in step 1.

With image options the hash lookup is skipped.
Setup for the next request: opens an upload for it to cancel.

Cancels the upload and deletes what arrived at once. An abandoned upload is deleted by itself after 24 hours anyway.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | Upload id from `POST /v1/uploads`. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `204` | Cancelled, no body. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | The upload does not exist or has expired. |

item.name: 4. Delivery
item.description:
How a browser, an app or a CDN gets the file: publicly (`/o`), with a token (`/p`) and through
a temporary link (`/t`). All three support `Range`, `ETag` and conditional requests.

request.description: Serves a public file **without a token** — the address from `publicUrl`. Put it into ``, hand it to users and to a CDN. Works only for public files — in the bucket root or in a folder with `public: true`; others answer `404`. Images, video, audio, PDF and plain text open in the browser, everything else downloads; HTML and SVG always download. `?download=1` asks for a download in any case. **Token:** not needed **Parameters** | Name | In | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `bucketId` | path | yes | Bucket id. | | `id` | path | yes | File id from the `id` field, 16 characters. | | `download` | query | | `1` — download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) instead of opening. | | `Range` | header | | A byte range, e.g. `bytes=0-1023` — answers `206`. | | `If-None-Match` | header | | An `ETag` received before: when the file has not changed — `304` with no body. | **Responses** | Code | When | |---|---| | `200` | The file content. Headers: `Content-Type`, `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Cache-Control`, `Content-Disposition`, `Accept-Ranges`. | | `206` | The requested byte range; `Content-Range` header. | | `304` | The file has not changed since that `ETag` — no body. | | `404` | The file is not public or does not exist. |

item.name: Check whether the file changed · ETag

request.description: A conditional request: the `ETag` from an earlier answer in `If-None-Match`. Unchanged file — `304` with no body, no traffic spent. Browsers and CDNs do this themselves.

item.name: Download part of a file · Range

request.description: Only the requested byte range — `206 Partial Content`. This is how resuming and video seeking work.
Asks the browser to save the file: `Content-Disposition: attachment`. Works on `/o` and `/p`.

Serves **any** file of the bucket — public or private — with a token; the address from
`privateUrl`. A `BASIC` token is enough: such a token can ship inside a client app — it cannot
list files, only fetch those whose `id` it knows. The answer is cached by the browser only.

**Token:** `BASIC`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | File id from the `id` field, 16 characters. |
| `download` | query |  | `1` — download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) instead of opening. |
| `Range` | header |  | A byte range, e.g. `bytes=0-1023` — answers `206`. |
| `If-None-Match` | header |  | An `ETag` received before: when the file has not changed — `304` with no body. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The file content. Headers: `Content-Type`, `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Cache-Control`, `Content-Disposition`, `Accept-Ranges`. |
| `206` | The requested byte range; `Content-Range` header. |
| `304` | The file has not changed since that `ETag` — no body. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such file in the bucket of the token. |

item.name: 5. Files
item.description: List, search, rename and move. Deleting is in "8. Cleanup".

request.description:
Returns the files of the bucket page by page, with search and sorting.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query |  | Page number, from 1. |
| `limit` | query |  | Records per page. |
| `search` | query |  | Search by name, case-insensitive. |
| `folder` | query |  | Folder name. An empty value (`folder=`) — the root only. Without it — all files. |
| `sort` | query |  | Sort field. |
| `dir` | query |  | Direction. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of files. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `403` | The token is disabled, expired, or its level is too low. |

Changes the name of the file and the folder it is in. The content and the `id` stay.

`folder` says **where the file will be after the request**. To only rename a file inside a
folder, pass that folder's name — otherwise the file moves to the root.

A moved file takes the rules of its new folder — visibility and retention; retention counts from
the move. **Moving to the root makes the file public**: it opens at `/o/…` without a token.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | File id from the `id` field, 16 characters. |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | New name. `/`, `\` and control characters become `-`; the extension is not adjusted. |
| `folder` | string | null |  | The folder the file should end up in. Without it — the root. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The file with its new `name`, `folder`, `public` and `expiresAt`. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such file in the bucket of the token. |
| `409` | The name is already taken in that folder. |
| `422` | No such folder, or the name is empty once cleaned. |

item.name: 6. Temporary links
item.description:
A `/t/…` link to one file: opens without a token, but only until it expires and, if needed,
a limited number of times. Works for private files too.

request.description:
Issues a signed `/t/…` link to the file. It opens without a token, but only until it expires.

**Two kinds.** Without `maxDownloads` and `revocable` the link is **signed**: it is not stored,
`id: null`, and cannot be revoked on its own — only all links of the bucket at once. With either
field it is **tracked**: stored, counts downloads, revocable on its own.

**Token:** `FULL`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | File id from the `id` field, 16 characters. |

**Request body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ttl` | integer | yes | Lifetime, seconds: up to 30 days. |
| `disposition` | `0` · `1` |  | Open in the browser or download. (`0` open in the browser, `1` download) |
| `maxDownloads` | integer |  | Download limit. Makes the link tracked. |
| `revocable` | boolean |  | Revocable on its own. Makes the link tracked. |
| `note` | string |  | A note for yourself. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `201` | The link is issued. |
| `401` | No token, or the token is unknown. |
| `404` | No such file in the bucket of the token. |
| `422` | Validation failed — for example, `ttl` over 30 days. |

item.name: Issue a link with a download limit

Serves the file through a temporary link, without a token. After expiry, revocation or the download limit — `404`. Open or download is set when issuing, by `disposition`.

**Token:** not needed

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | yes | The signed part of the link after `/t/`. |
| `Range` | header |  | A byte range, e.g. `bytes=0-1023` — answers `206`. |
| `If-None-Match` | header |  | An `ETag` received before: when the file has not changed — `304` with no body. |

**Responses**

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | The file content. Headers: `Content-Type`, `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Cache-Control`, `Content-Disposition`, `Accept-Ranges`. |
| `206` | The requested byte range; `Content-Range` header. |
| `304` | The file has not changed since that `ETag` — no body. |
| `404` | The link expired, was revoked or is used up. |
